physics.momentum: -grad(p) + div(2 eta e) + f = 0; e=(grad v + grad v.T)/2; div(v)=0
physics.domain: uniform Cartesian 2D rectangle; x-right/z-up; eliminated normal wall velocities, zero tangential shear traction; zero domain-mean dynamic pressure
physics.normal_stress: 2 eta_cell du/dx and 2 eta_cell dw/dz at centres
physics.shear_stress: eta_vertex*(du/dz+dw/dx) at interior vertices; zero wall shear
physics.rheology: unchanged R3 constant, Tosi-linear and Tosi-plastic profiles; no new parameters inferred from room-temperature mineral library
physics.invariant: eII=sqrt(e:e/2); at each stress site reconstruct missing strain components by symmetric adjacent-centre/vertex arithmetic means
physics.temperature: supplied centre T; interior-vertex T is adjacent four-centre arithmetic mean; depth is down from top using distinct R3 depth scale
physics.plastic_conventions: retain Tosi Frobenius q=sqrt(2)*eII and factor-two harmonic mean; no artificial minimum rate; linear controls remain distinct
physics.memory: BF profile permitted only for separate mechanical snapshots with an explicitly supplied frozen damage field; no advection, healing, or coupled localisation claim
physics.composition: named binary fraction contributes buoyancy; no unregistered compositional strength factor
physics.heating: no extra dissipation/slab pull/latent/adiabatic source; retained R4.2 explicit source accounting unchanged
physics.coupling: explicit mechanical_mode=variable-r4.3; existing two RK stages independently converge current rheology before their fluxes are accepted; retained Strang thermal operators, Courant and balance gates
physics.legacy: default constant-r4.2 contract and canonical old descriptors unchanged; decoded snapshots do not gain new guarantees or permit changed-source continuation

numerics.sparse_velocity: 2 Bx.T eta_c Bx + 2 Bz.T eta_c Bz + S.T eta_v S
numerics.normal_solve: matrix-free full saddle matvec with sparse velocity-ILU/block triangular preconditioner and native GMRES
numerics.pressure_preconditioner: projected local -2*eta_cell inverse-Schur approximation; gauge handled separately; contrast-sensitive, not exact spectral inverse
numerics.reference: small independently assembled sparse-direct saddle solve, explicitly selected; no fallback
numerics.nonlinear: fixed-policy Picard, default relaxation 1; true updated-law momentum and log-viscosity change required, then independent returned-SI gates
numerics.limits_meaning: finite admission/convergence envelope, not acceptance of every coefficient field within it; failure is explicit, no law/tolerance downgrade
numerics.factor_reuse: symbolic derivative matrices retained; at most one numerical factor keyed by exact normalised coefficient bytes; unchanged reuse, changed coefficients rebuild
numerics.publication: actual returned SI velocity, pressure and viscosity checked against independent stress/continuity/work balances; updated rheology re-evaluated at rounded returned fields

verification.time_oracle: eight-variable thermal/composition ODE using independent scalar-root mechanics + donor/heat matrices, DOP853; no Atlas mechanical operator in RHS
